priorityList: Cast Bestial Wrath on cooldown, ideally paired with offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racials.
Sync offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racials (like Berserking or Blood Fury) with your Bestial Wrath windows.
Cast Barbed Shot if Bestial Wrath's cooldown is less than 1.5 seconds to maximize its cooldown reduction.
Cast Wild Thrash on cooldown to maximize Sentinel hero talent value.
Cast Kill Command as your primary priority for damage and Kill Cleave, prioritizing it even more if Nature's Ally (Sentinel Owl) or Apex Predator is active.
Cast Wailing Arrow during Bestial Wrath or if the target is nearly dead.
Cast Barbed Shot to maintain 3 stacks of Frenzy on your pet or to prevent capping at 2 charges.
Cast Cobra Shot if the Hogstrider buff is active and you are fighting 2 or 3 targets.
Cast Cobra Shot as a filler whenever Kill Command and Wild Thrash are on cooldown.
Use any available utility or remaining combat trinkets on cooldown.
